datasets.title: Saint Kitts and Nevis Buildings (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 15.7 thousand buildings in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 51% of the total buildings.The average age of data for this region is 2 years ( Last edited 3 months ago ) and 28% buildings were added or updated in the last 6 months. lineage.description: Building footprints and attributes were extracted from OpenStreetMap for Saint Kitts and Nevis and exported in multiple geospatial formats (SHP, KML, GeoJSON, GeoPackage) by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team. The dataset represents approximately 51% of estimated total buildings based on AI-mapping validation, with an average data age of 2 years and 28% of features updated within the last 6 months.
